prompt: Implement order(deps) in topo.py: `deps` maps each task name to the list of names it depends on (a name only mentioned as a dependency is a task too). Return every task in an order where each comes after all it depends on; among tasks ready at the same time, take them in alphabetical order, so the answer is unique. If there is a cycle, raise CycleError (define it in topo.py, a subclass of ValueError) whose .cycle attribute is the list of names around one cycle, starting from its alphabetically smallest name and ending with that name again (like ["a", "c", "b", "a"]).
